items.title: April 2024 — Bomber Operations Begin
items.body: Our first bomber operations get underway.

items.title: May 2024 — Solo Bomber Operations
items.body: 10–15 flights per night, delivering “presents” to the enemy.

items.title: July 2024 — The Vampire Arrives
items.body: The Vampire team begins operations, bringing a whole new scale of “presents.”

items.title: July 2024 — The Vampire Arrives
items.body: The Vampire team begins operations, bringing a whole new scale of “presents.”

items.title: November 2024 — Operations Continue
items.body: Regular drops continue and the complexity of missions keeps growing.

items.title: January–April 2025 — Team Expansion
items.body: The Vampire team expands, taking on increasingly complex tasks and missions.

items.title: June 2025 — Rebuilding After Loss
items.body: The Vampire team is destroyed. The future Assemblya team begins rebuilding and repairing what remains.

items.title: August 2025 — A Separate Bomber Unit
items.body: A dedicated bomber unit is established. Git takes responsibility for leading the entire unit.

items.title: February 2026 — Second Team Established
items.body: A second team is created, fully trained, and receives its certifications.

items.title: May 2026 — Bumblebee FPV dropper Joins the Unit
items.body: The Bumblebee team joins our unit. The idea behind Assemblya finally takes shape.

items.title: Summer 2026 — The Work Continues
items.body: Operations continue. We keep delivering a warm welcome to our enemy.
